name: Komon Winaq
description: The first humans of Ixalan, who awoke in the Core of Paradise and later founded the Sun Empire and Oltec civilization.

description_citations.text: "Ixalan (plane)". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: A fungal outbreak strikes Topizielo in the Ixalan caverns, the beginning of the mycoids.

citation.text: "Fungus", section "Ixalan". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Komon and Oltec humans flee the caverns for the surface, while those who remain seal off the Core.
timeline.quote: The Komon and Oltec in the caverns fled, finding safety outside of the caverns.

citation.text: "Fungus", section "Ixalan". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The first humans, the Komon Winaq, awake inside the Core of Paradise and understand Chimil as their creator.
timeline.quote: they would be called the Komon Winaq , or the Fifth People

citation.text: "Ixalan (plane)", section "Fifth Age". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Aclazotz's cults spread, and the Whispering War erupts when leaders try to stop them.
timeline.quote: Aclazotz's cults fought back, and the fields and cities of the Komon raged with violence.

citation.text: "Ixalan (plane)", section "Whispering War". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Komon build a golden Age of the Sun lasting millennia, founding Oteclan on Lake Wachibal.
timeline.quote: the Komon Winaq built a golden age that lasted for millennia

citation.text: "Ixalan (plane)", section "Age of the Sun". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Fomori arrive, end the Age of the Sun and enclose Chimil in a shell, plunging the Core into darkness.
timeline.quote: the Fomori completed their shell around Chimil, and total darkness fell throughout the Core

citation.text: "Ixalan (plane)", section "Age of the Sun". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Chimil shatters the shards, blasting away the Fomori and empowering the Komon into Ixalan's first angels; the Deep Gods return.

citation.text: "Ixalan (plane)", section "Night War". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Hundreds of thousands of Komon Winaq migrate to the surface, later becoming the Sun Empire, while those who stay become the Oltec.
timeline.quote: Those who stayed behind began to call themselves Oltec .

citation.text: "Ixalan (plane)", section "First Exodus". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: A fungal outbreak at Topizielo spawns the mycoids, which overrun the caverns; the Oltec seal the Core's entrances.
timeline.quote: Those who remained in the caverns sealed all entrances to the Core to protect it from the spread of the mycoids.

citation.text: "Ixalan (plane)", section "Birth of the Mycotyrant". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Cults of Aclazotz fight back against the Komon Winaq leaders, and violence rages through their fields and cities.
timeline.quote: Aclazotz's cults fought back, and the fields and cities of the Komon Winaq raged with violence.

citation.text: "Aclazotz", section "Whispering  War". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Cosmium lashed out from Chimil, blasting away the colonizers and making the Komon the first angels of Ixalan.

citation.text: "Chimil", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Fomori arrive and establish dominion over the Core, completing a shell around Chimil that plunges the Core into darkness.
timeline.quote: the Fomori completed their shell around Chimil, and total darkness fell throughout the Core

citation.text: "Core of Paradise", section "Age of the Sun". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Chimil shatters the shards of her cage, blasting away the Fomori and creating the first angels of Ixalan.

citation.text: "Core of Paradise", section "Night War". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Cosmium lashes out from Chimil, blasting the colonizers and creating the first angels from the Komon.
timeline.quote: Cosmium lashed out from Chimil, blasting away the colonizers

citation.text: "Cosmium", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: An outbreak of fungal disease strikes one of the Komon's grandest cities, the beginning of the mycoids.
timeline.quote: This fungus was the beginning of the mycoids

citation.text: "Mycotyrant", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.
